verdict.rationale: Delaware Division of Revenue publishes public web documentation, including a section for tax software developers, so agent-oriented docs are a fair question for it. Direct probes found no such docs: llms.txt, the markdown doc variant and every OpenAPI candidate path returned HTTP 404. Nothing in the evidence shows an llms.txt file or agent-oriented documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
